decisions.reason: As an improved and renamed version of an already liked trommel screen, it appears to meet or exceed aspiration levels and an established German machinery firm would usually retain such a platform product.
Its continued mention alongside an EU Stage V update suggests the line remained relevant and compliant, so despite some uncertainty the likely choice is to keep it rather than redeploy resources.
The move from a simple mention in 2018 to a dedicated page in 2019 indicates rising internal commitment and at least acceptable market feedback, which supports keeping it under bounded rationality.
Management language that the new CERON generation is setting standards points to performance above aspiration and enough confidence to continue the product family.
